verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's marketing pages describe a first-party Transaction Monitoring agent within Mesh agentic workflows that auto-remediates level 1 alerts and escalates high-risk or complex cases for human review, which covers the core of in-product alert investigation. The evidence is thin, short marketing claims only, and nothing shows the agent writing review notes or case narratives for analysts. missing for 10: evidence the agent prepares review notes or investigation summaries, in-depth documentation of how the transaction agent investigates alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
